title: Container queries: components that adapt themselves
why_it_matters: Components stay reusable when they respond to their own space.
explanation: A media query asks about the screen. A container query asks about the parent. Mark a parent with container-type: inline-size, then use @container to style children based on its width. The same card can look right in a sidebar or main column.
try_it: Place one card component in a narrow and a wide parent and compare.
